stage.coordinate_convention: normalized within exact CALL stage; origin top-left

method.notes: Actual real-candidate-call.png was opened and cropped using the exact stage bounds from real-candidate-call.xml. Only visibly separable object envelopes were measured. Values are intentionally limited to reliable broad geometry and are not pixel-segmentation claims. Bed, foreground table/laptop/plant, floor lamp, nightstands, small plant and wall-art targets are excluded here where occlusion, perspective or target semantics make the visible bbox ambiguous.

room_rug.notes: Visible patterned rug envelope only; Celine/bed/foreground occlusion remains. This measurement is geometry-envelope evidence, not a material/banding PASS.

excluded_from_score.room_bed: partly occluded by Celine; visible left envelope is not a stable proxy for the target semantics
excluded_from_score.room_foreground_table: perspective boundary is not a single stable bbox top edge
excluded_from_score.room_reference_foreground_laptop: existing target file carries a dedicated quadrilateral contract; do not replace it with a coarse bbox
excluded_from_score.room_reference_foreground_plant: foreground occlusion/clipping makes this baseline bbox ambiguous
excluded_from_score.room_reference_foreground_candle: not reliably separable in this proof
excluded_from_score.room_reference_right_wall_art: not needed for broad geometry baseline
excluded_from_score.room_reference_left_wall_art_pair: not needed for broad geometry baseline
